headline: Coinbase Ireland Fined $3.6 Million by Central Bank over Safeguarding Failures
summary: Ireland's central bank fined Coinbase's local unit $3.6 million for failures in safeguarding user funds and an excessive reliance on its global parent company.
why: Regulatory enforcement actions against major crypto exchanges highlight increasing compliance scrutiny and operational risks for digital asset firms operating in multiple jurisdictions.

impacts.name: Coinbase Global
impacts.why: A financial penalty and regulatory reprimand in Ireland highlight compliance costs and operational oversight risks.
